stages.stageDescription: Networking, TCP/IP, OSI model, packet inspection, and Linux systems security.

items.whyRecommended: Essential to understand how data moves across networks and how exploits are delivered.
practiceTasks: Capture network traffic and analyze TCP three-way handshake, DNS queries, and TLS handshakes
items.projectApplication: Network anomaly detection script flagging abnormal port scans or SYN floods
items.completionCriteria: Explain IP addressing, subnetting, CIDR, and transport vs application layer security

stages.stageDescription: Application vulnerabilities, OWASP Top 10, cryptography, and penetration testing tools.

items.whyRecommended: Covers the most critical risks to web applications including SQLi, XSS, Broken Auth, and SSRF.
practiceTasks: Solve PortSwigger Academy labs on SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting, and IDOR
items.projectApplication: Security vulnerability audit report identifying and remediating flaws in a target application
items.completionCriteria: Demonstrate understanding of root causes and defensive controls (sanitization, CSP, parameterized queries)

stages.stageDescription: SIEM log monitoring, threat hunting, vulnerability scanning, and incident response.

items.whyRecommended: Core responsibility for SOC analysts protecting organizations from ongoing intrusions.

recommendedResources.title: NIST Computer Security Incident Handling Guide (SP 800-61)

practiceTasks: Set up Wazuh/Splunk and write search queries to detect brute-force attacks and privilege escalation
items.projectApplication: Automated incident response playbook that isolates compromised IPs automatically
items.completionCriteria: Detect simulated credential stuffing attack in real-time logs within 3 minutes

stages.stageDescription: Cloud security posture, identity governance, exploit development, and zero-trust architecture.

items.whyRecommended: Crucial for safeguarding modern cloud-native environments and SaaS platforms.
practiceTasks: Implement least-privilege IAM policies, AWS KMS key rotation, and audit logging with CloudTrail
items.projectApplication: Comprehensive cloud security baseline automated check using open-source compliance tools
items.completionCriteria: Audit score reaches 100% compliance against CIS Benchmarks

stages.stageDescription: End-to-end security audit and hardened infrastructure deployment.

items.topic: Capstone: Full Application Penetration Test & Security Hardening
items.whyRecommended: Shows comprehensive offensive and defensive acumen to prospective employers.
practiceTasks: Perform full manual code audit and automated scanning on a full-stack web application
items.projectApplication: Formal executive vulnerability assessment report with CVSS scoring and verified code fixes
items.completionCriteria: Document 5 confirmed vulnerabilities, reproduce them with PoC exploits, and verify fixes

stages.stageDescription: Scenario-based incident response questions, threat modeling, and technical certifications.

items.whyRecommended: Evaluates methodical thinking, threat actor motivation analysis, and risk mitigation.
practiceTasks: Conduct STRIDE threat model on microservice payment processing architecture
items.projectApplication: Formal data flow diagram with documented attack surface mitigations
items.completionCriteria: Fluently walk through incident containment, eradication, and recovery steps

stages.stageDescription: Security certification roadmap (Security+, CEH, OSCP) and ethical disclosure guidelines.

items.whyRecommended: Industry recognized certifications validate technical integrity.
practiceTasks: Review bug bounty platforms (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) rules of engagement
items.projectApplication: Curated security research portfolio with write-ups of CTF challenges and patched CVEs
items.completionCriteria: Published CTF write-ups demonstrating clear technical methodology
